instructions.name: initialize
docs: Bootstrap the program config + verdict-authority PDA.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The verdict-authority signer PDA. Not initialized (holds no data); we only
need its bump, stored in the config for CPI signing.

instructions.name: register_moderator
docs: Admin registers a moderator (wallet + on-chain recipient + label).

instructions.name: set_moderator_active
docs: A moderator pauses/resumes itself.

instructions.name: submit_verdict
docs: A registered, active moderator records a verdict → CPI into the escrow.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The moderator's own wallet.

accounts.name: config
docs: The moderation config the mod is registered under (authenticated via the
moderator's `has_one = config`).

accounts.name: verdict_authority
docs: The `[b"authority", config]` signer PDA = the escrow's settlement
authority. Signs the CPI; holds no data.

accounts.name: moderator
docs: The registered moderator — must be active and bound to `config` + signer.

accounts.name: escrow_config
docs: The escrow's protocol config. Its `settlement_authority` must equal
`verdict_authority` — enforced inside `record_verdict`.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not a registered, active moderator

errors.name: StringTooLong
errors.msg: Recipient or label exceeds the maximum length

types.name: Config
docs: Global protocol config (PDA, seeds = [b"config", authority]).
Seeded with `authority` so the config is deterministic per-admin and not a
squattable global singleton. Holds protocol-level parameters so fees,
treasury, the settlement authority, and the kill-switch can change without
redeploying the program.
Note: because `authority` is part of the seed, the top-level admin cannot be
rotated in place (the PDA address would change). `settlement_authority` is a
field, not a seed, so it rotates freely — which is what the V1->V2 seam needs.
Backward-compat discipline:
- `version` is the first field (byte 8) for version dispatch / migrations.
- `reserved` is the LAST field. New fields are inserted immediately before
it and shrink it by their exact size, so the account size stays constant
(no `realloc`). Freed bytes are zeroed, so an added `Option<T>` reads None.

fields.name: version
docs: Schema version of this account. Set to `VERSION` at init.

fields.name: authority
docs: Admin — may update this config. Also part of the PDA seed.

fields.name: settlement_authority
docs: Key authorized to call `release` / `refund` on an escrow.
V1: the platform backend key, acting on the off-chain aggregated verdict.
V2: swapped (via `update_config`) to a PDA of the `desc_moderation`
program, so on-chain moderator consensus settles escrows via CPI. The
escrow accounts never change — this indirection is the V1->V2 seam.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Destination for the protocol fee.

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: Base protocol fee in basis points (200 = 2%).

fields.name: paused
docs: Global kill-switch — blocks new escrows / settlements when true.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Forward-compat padding. Carve new fields from here.

types.name: Escrow
docs: Per-deal escrow account (PDA, seeds = [b"escrow", initiator, contract_id]).
Holds the funds-relevant state for one contract. Subjective data (the
verdict reasoning, deliverable contents, criteria, moderator identities)
stays off-chain in V1; this account records only the money, the lifecycle,
and audit hashes of what was submitted and what verdict was acted on.
Backward-compat discipline:
- `version` is the first field (byte 8) for version dispatch / migrations.
- `reserved` is the LAST field. New fields are inserted immediately before
it and shrink it by their exact size, so the account size stays constant
(no `realloc`). Freed bytes are zeroed, so an added `Option<T>` reads None.

fields.name: version
docs: Schema version of this account. Set to `VERSION` at init.

fields.name: config
docs: The protocol `Config` governing this escrow. Bound at creation so later
instructions load the *current* `settlement_authority` / `treasury` live
(keeping `settlement_authority` rotatable — the V1->V2 seam).

fields.name: committer
docs: None until the shareable link is accepted by a committer.

fields.name: mint
docs: USDC mint used for this deal.

fields.name: vault
docs: PDA token account holding the deposited funds.

fields.name: amount
docs: Payout to the committer on success (USDC, 1e6 base units).

fields.name: protocol_fee
docs: Protocol fee, snapshotted at creation so a later Config change can't
alter the agreed terms of an in-flight deal.

fields.name: moderator_surcharge
docs: Total surcharge flowing to moderator operators.

fields.name: moderator_count
docs: Number of moderators, set by the protocol from contract value.

fields.name: outcome
docs: Set by `record_verdict`; None until a verdict is attested.

fields.name: verdict_hash
docs: Hash of the aggregated verdict JSON the settlement acted on (zeroed until
recorded). On-chain audit trail for the "neutral trust layer".

fields.name: deliverable_hash
docs: Hash of the deliverable the committer submitted (zeroed until submitted).

fields.name: deadline
docs: Unix timestamp — submission deadline. Governs the ghosting refund only.

fields.name: submitted_at
docs: When the committer submitted (None until `Submitted`). Off-chain SLA
clock starts here; not used as an on-chain timer.

fields.name: contract_id
docs: Links to the off-chain contract; also part of the PDA seed.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Forward-compat padding so V2 fields (e.g. `parent`, `moderation_account`,
`dispute_account`) can be added without a risky `realloc`. Carve new
fields from here; keep this the LAST field.

types.name: EscrowStatus
docs: On-chain lifecycle of an escrow — only the transitions that move money.
The richer off-chain contract states (draft, under_verification, disputed)
have no on-chain representation.
Invariant: once `Submitted`, funds are frozen until a verdict is recorded —
the deadline is irrelevant from that point. Pass -> committer, Fail ->
initiator, and nothing else can move the money.
APPEND-ONLY: borsh indexes variants by declaration order. New variants (e.g.
a future `Disputed`) must be added at the END — never reorder or insert.

types.name: ModerationConfig
docs: Program config (PDA, seeds = [b"config", admin]).
Seeded with `admin` so the config is deterministic per-platform and not a
squattable global singleton (mirrors `desc_escrow`'s `Config`). It is the
root of the verdict-authority chain: the escrow's `settlement_authority` is
set to this program's `[b"authority", config]` signer PDA, so the *only* way
to record a verdict is through this program — and the only way to make it act
is a registered moderator's signature.
Backward-compat discipline (same as desc_escrow):
- `version` is the first field for version dispatch / migrations.
- `reserved` is the LAST field. New fields are carved from it so the account
size stays constant (no `realloc`); freed bytes are zeroed.

fields.name: version
docs: Schema version of this account. Set to `VERSION` at init.

fields.name: admin
docs: Platform admin — may `register_moderator`. Also part of the PDA seed.

fields.name: escrow_program
docs: The `desc_escrow` program this config authorizes verdicts for (CPI target).

fields.name: min_verdicts
docs: Verdicts required to settle a contract. V1 = 1; k-of-n consensus is V2.

fields.name: authority_bump
docs: Bump of the `[b"authority", config]` signer PDA — the escrow's
`settlement_authority`. Stored so `submit_verdict` can sign the CPI.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Forward-compat padding (V2: fee/reward params, …). Keep it LAST.

types.name: Moderator
docs: A registered moderator (PDA, seeds = [b"moderator", authority]).
One per moderator wallet. Holds the mod's signing identity, its public
encryption key (so the *chain* is the source of truth for what committers
seal deliverables to), and an active flag the mod controls itself.
V1: registered by the platform admin (internal mods). V2: permissionless
registration gated by stake — those fields are carved from `reserved`.
Backward-compat discipline: `version` first, `reserved` LAST (see
`ModerationConfig`).

fields.name: version
docs: Schema version of this account. Set to `VERSION` at init.

fields.name: config
docs: The `ModerationConfig` this moderator is registered under. Bound at
registration so a verdict can't be signed under a different config.

fields.name: authority
docs: The moderator's own non-custodial wallet. Signs `set_moderator_active`
and `submit_verdict`. Also part of the PDA seed.

fields.name: recipient
docs: Public `age` recipient (e.g. `age1...`) — what committers encrypt
deliverables to. On-chain so nobody can swap a mod's key.

fields.name: label
docs: Human-readable label (platform-set).

fields.name: active
docs: Whether this mod may currently judge. Toggled by the mod itself.

fields.name: registered_at
docs: Unix timestamp of registration.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Forward-compat padding (V2: stake, reputation, …). Keep it LAST.

types.name: Outcome
docs: Aggregated verdict result, attested on-chain by the settlement authority.
The authority only *records* this; the parties themselves execute the
transfer (so payout never depends on the authority being online).
APPEND-ONLY: add new variants at the END only (see `EscrowStatus`).
